svg.text: Pirouz death · five reasons · the unnamed wild cubs · the outro

g.text: پیروز · PIROUZ
۲۸ اسفند ۱۴۰۱ — یوزپلنگ پیروز درگذشت · 28 ESFAND 1401 — PIROUZ HAS DIED
SC 4 · SH 7 · MS MURAL + CHILD · 35mm
Static · 5 sec hold · fingertip-to-paw is the cut point
Preceded by 3-sec hold on Farsi news ticker (red strip)
4.7 Mural + child — the death beat
The whole film compresses into one frame.
"A nation grieved a cat. The cat knew nothing of it."
5-sec static · then truck blasts through
SC 5 · SH 1 · STATIC HIGHWAY · 35mm
Hold 5 sec empty · truck enters and exits frame in <1 sec
SOUND: silence builds, truck shatters it
5.1 Highway, plateau
Reason #1: roads. The truck is the whole argument.
Tehran–Mashhad corridor (research §4).
cub jumps on sibling — slow-mo if possible
SC 6 · SH 1 · CAMERA-TRAP · static IR
7 sec hold · only playful cheetah image in film
The counter-argument. The door left open.
6.1 Unnamed cubs, wadi
Anonymous on purpose. The film respects their safety.
Followed by daytime drone of empty wadi (the absence).
یوزپلنگ
imitating cat — paws up
SC 6 · SH 4 · WIDE LS · 28mm
Soft window key camera-left · 5 sec · child action mid-line
Pull-quote card precedes this · classroom inherits the argument
6.4 Rural classroom — inheritance
"The children, in the end, are the only ones who will inherit."
Imitation = laughter = the door open.
end-of-move frame
SC 7 · SH 1 · CRANE-UP DRONE · 24mm
10 sec slow ascent · ghost frame shows end position
MUSIC: cello note returns, fuller · "The difference is us."
7.1 Drone ascent over plateau
The plateau widens. The audience is given altitude.
First and only first-person plural: "us."
CAM 22 · NAYBANDAN · ARCHIVE
"Twelve. Still breathing."
SC 7 · SH 3 · CAMERA-TRAP STILL · static CU
6 sec hold · then cut to black · end-card follows
Bookends Sec 1 eyeshine — the film closes the loop
7.3 Final still — head-on, eyes glowing
The film ends where it began. The animal still here.
End-card "In memory of Pirouz" follows over wind.
